<h2>Assemble Cached Selected sjSDM Folds</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Reconstructs the established selected-candidate OOF prediction and
diagnostic artifacts from tuning-time probabilities without fitting the
selected candidate again.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>assemble_sjsdm_cached_selected_folds(
  data_assignments = NULL,
  data_selected_candidate = NULL,
  data_sample_ids = NULL,
  taxon_names = NULL,
  list_prediction_cache = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_assignments">data_assignments</code>, <code id="data_selected_candidate">data_selected_candidate</code>, <code id="data_sample_ids">data_sample_ids</code>, <code id="taxon_names">taxon_names</code></td>
<td>
<p>Inputs accepted by [run_sjsdm_selected_candidate_folds()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="list_prediction_cache">list_prediction_cache</code></td>
<td>
<p>Fold caches returned by [run_sjsdm_tuning_candidates()] when
'retain_prediction_cache = TRUE'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list with the unchanged 'data_predictions' and 'data_diagnostics'
public schemas. Diagnostic fit seeds identify the tuning fits that produced
the reused probabilities.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
assemble_sjsdm_cached_selected_folds(
  data_assignments = data_assignments,
  data_selected_candidate = data_selected_candidate,
  data_sample_ids = data_sample_ids,
  taxon_names = taxon_names,
  list_prediction_cache = list_prediction_cache
)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>
